comment.text: FGFR1 K687 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Acute lymphoblastic leukemia; Bladder tumors; Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Hematologic neoplasms; CNS tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
